Assuming you meant **"What is the longest river in South America?"**:

The longest river in South America is the **Amazon River**, which stretches approximately **4,000 miles (6,400 km)** across the continent (and by some measurements up to 4,345 miles / 6,992 km). It is also the largest river in the world by discharge volume of water.

*(Note: If you meant **North America**, the longest river is the **Missouri River** at about 2,341 miles / 3,767 km, closely followed by the Mississippi River).*
